title: Source-free proof of the fixed2by11pair-column exchange
timing: Root requested this proof before running the selected GDT1303empirical source screen and stated it would wait for delivery. No source/target counts or experimental metrics were opened by the producer. This is not a claim of independence from previously exposed research.

fixed_contract.scope: Unchanged old1228/1268bare Deot projected source, its ordered words and sections. Pair consecutive source logical positions0/1,2/3...across word gaps; reset each section. Odd final unit stays unchanged.
fixed_contract.output: Integers0..21with one arbitrary fixed bijection to22working drawings. Restore original word lengths and gaps; no added escape or new source normalization.

involution.proof: The first application preserves rows and swaps columns. The second preserves those rows and swaps the columns back. Thus F(F(x,y))=(x,y)for every pair of table cells.
involution.whole_message: The operation preserves unit count and every gap position. Encoder and decoder therefore identify the same consecutive pair slots after ignoring gaps within a section. Involution on each pair, identity on an odd final unit and the same section resets prove a whole projected-message inverse.

paired_equality.statement: At an actually processed pair, x=y if and only if F(x,y)'s two output cells are equal.
paired_equality.proof: Output equality is r1=r2and c2=c1, exactly input equality. A fixed injective output-unit relabeling preserves this equivalence.
paired_equality.limit: This is not equality preservation at every adjacent edge. Edges between successive processing pairs, word boundaries and the odd final unit require their actual phase; no new empirical count follows.

other_exact_properties: The row coordinate remains at its original source position. The pair's column multiset is preserved. The complete-letter multiset need not be preserved: ranks0,12become1,11.

One source-letter substitution affects at most its pair's two output slots. Inserting/deleting a source letter can shift the rest of the section's pair alignment; no stronger error-localization claim is made.

Every word's output length equals its projected source length. The crossed-column operation may change within-word conditional entropy relative to the source. A subsequent global OUTPUT-UNIT bijection preserves the generated stream's empirical conditional entropy and all word lengths; this does not describe an arbitrary whole-group relabeling.
The procedure need not be a deterministic word-to-word map: a boundary pair can depend on the first/last letter of a neighboring source word.

hand_examples_not_executed.purpose: cross-word pairing plus odd terminal identity
unequal same-column pair can be unchanged but remains unequal
same-row pair swaps whole cells as a special case, not the general rule

critical_boundaries: Use source logical sequence order only, not visual reversal of Hebrew text. No alternate orientation or pair phase is searched.
Word gaps are copied at the same unit offsets. A gap inside a processed pair is retained between its two outputs; a physical line wrap does not create a new pair reset.
A source section with zero or one letter has respectively no pairs or one unchanged unit. Never pad an odd final unit or pair it with the next section.

The full old projection is preserved; its earlier loss of points, final-form distinctions or editorial material is not undone. Old larger source alphabets cannot enter without a separately declared channel, which is not proposed.
The empirical old1228screen remains a fixed-source necessary comparison, not a proof that the selected source is Voynich, a new source-language exclusion, or a historical cipher finding.

Prior fixed-gap sign swap,929folded coordinates,883overlap and1268difference failures remain unchanged. No identity of this new fixed operation with those contracts was found in the bounded primary review.
verdict: The declared algebraic writer/inverse and paired-equality lemma are valid. Source statistical compatibility, actual handwriting practicality and manuscript binding are unassessed.
actions: No code, synthetic run, source encoding, native query, image, optimizer, new meaning or root-owned file modification. One RAW retention and this separate proof note only.
